_README: Apollo persisted-query full-body strings for Walmart's GraphQL operations. Captured from real checkout flows; used as the fallback body when the persisted-query hash returns PERSISTED_QUERY_NOT_FOUND (Apollo Client #10253). Walmart rotates hashes ~weekly; with these query bodies present, the bot self-heals via APQ full-query retry instead of falling back to slow DOM checkout. Capture new bodies via walmart/apq_capture.py reading walmart/logs/checkout_capture_*.jsonl. PLACEHOLDER bodies are intentionally minimal — they're enough to trigger the retry code path and let the sim accept the request, but real production captures will replace them. When that capture lands, swap the placeholder with the verbatim query field from the JSONL.

queries.ItemByIdBtf: query ItemByIdBtf($itemId: String!) { product(itemId: $itemId) { usItemId name availabilityStatus showAtc sellerId sellerName priceInfo { currentPrice { price } } } }
queries.updateItems: mutation updateItems($getDetailedAccesspoint: Boolean, $input: UpdateItemsInput!, $includePartialFulfillmentSwitching: Boolean, $enableAEBadge: Boolean, $includeExpressSla: Boolean, $includeQueueing: Boolean, $enableCartBookslotShortcut: Boolean, $enableACCScheduling: Boolean, $enableWalmartPlusFreeDiscountedExpress: Boolean, $enableDiscountedOrHolidayExpress: Boolean, $enableBenefitSavings: Boolean, $enableUnifiedBadges: Boolean, $enableCartLevelMSI: Boolean, $enablePickupNotAvailable: Boolean, $enableReturnsLabel: Boolean, $enableStarRatings: Boolean, $enableSpendLimit: Boolean, $enableMsiMci: Boolean, $enableTaxBreakdown: Boolean, $enableI18nWave1: Boolean, $enableWplusPetBenefit: Boolean, $enableCartLevelPromotions: Boolean, $enableOrderCutOffTime: Boolean, $enableHotCartFeature: Boolean, $enableMOQ: Boolean, $enableMOQVariants: Boolean, $enablePetRxManualRefill: Boolean, $enableItemLevelTE: Boolean) { updateItems(input: $input) { lineItems { quantity offerId usItemId lineItemId } checkoutable } }
queries.CreateContract: mutation CreateContract($createContractInput: CreateContractInput!, $promosEnable: Boolean, $wplusEnabled: Boolean, $isACCEnabled: Boolean, $charityOfChoiceEnabled: Boolean, $enablePhotoMigration: Boolean, $wplusSplashSignupEnabled: Boolean, $enableTYPinDrop: Boolean, $enablePaidSignupBanner: Boolean, $enableAccessPoint: Boolean, $enableMsiMci: Boolean) { createPurchaseContract(input: $createContractInput) { id order { status } payments { amountPaid lastFour } } }
queries.getSlots: query getSlots($cartId: String!, $fulfillmentOption: FulfillmentOption!, $cartFulfillmentOption: FulfillmentOption, $isGuest: Boolean, $isExpressSla: Boolean) { slots(input: { cartId: $cartId, fulfillmentOption: $fulfillmentOption }) { slotDays { eachDaySlots { id available isSelectable fulfillmentType price { total { value } } startTime slaInMins slotMetadata } } } }
queries.reserveSlotMutation: mutation reserveSlotMutation($cartId: String!, $slotMetadata: String!, $selectedSlot: SlotInput!) { reserveSlot(input: { cartId: $cartId, slotMetadata: $slotMetadata, selectedSlot: $selectedSlot }) { checkoutable } }
